{npc:Tom}, Rookgaard's tanner, says an adventurer left a {item:Doublet} in the stable cellar before leaving for the mainland. Go down to the stable north of Tom's shop and use the loose board to get the doublet. There are no monsters on the way.
An adventurer used to keep his loot under a loose board in the northern stable, next to a strange note on the wall. Maybe he forgot something when he left.
Stable stairs north of Tom's shop
It is one of the fastest quests in Rookgaard: do it right at the start.
In Rookgaard village, go to {npc:Tom}'s shop (the tanner) and head to the stable right **north** of it. Go down the stable stairs to the cellar (1 floor down).
Down there, use the {item:Loose Board|loose board} that is **immediately to the left** of the {item:Sewer Grate|sewer grate}. You receive a {item:Doublet}.
The loose board to the left of the sewer grate
To leave, go back the same way: go up the same stairs and you are back in the stable, north of {npc:Tom}'s shop, in the village.
